annotations.title: Capital quality: who sits next to you

description: Who sits next to you in a vault? For one vault of $1M or more: cohort retention (of the capital that arrived in a month, the share whose address was still in after 30, 90 and 180 days), the mercenary share (capital that came on an advertised-APY spike and left within 30 days), concentration (the largest address, the ten largest, the Herfindahl index), the dollar-weighted median holding period, the share held by addresses that left other vaults 2 to 30 days before a loss or a one-day fall of half there, and churn (30-day gross in and out against capital). Each figure has its time, window and source, and is null with a reason where not read, never zero; quote the coverage beside the number. An address is not an owner. Without slug: one row per vault, sortable. Summary FREE; cohorts by month with flows.read.

limit.description: Without slug: how many vaults (default 20, at most 200).

slug.description: A vault slug (from list_vaults) or its address. Omit for the list.

sort.description: Without slug: the order (default tvl; retention lowest first).

name: vault_capital_quality

at.description: When the daily reading was taken.

meta.description: How current this answer is and what it was read from: `freshness` and the ages behind it. Present on every answer from this server, whatever the tool.

vault.description: With slug: retention, retentionHistory, mercenary, concentration, holding, earlyLeavers, churn (each with asOf, window, coverage, notRead), sources, says. Null in the list.

vaults.description: Without slug: one row per vault (retention30, mercenaryShare, top1, top10, hhi, holdingMedianDays, earlyLeaverShare, churnGross30). Empty with slug.

warnings.description: Anything the server wants a caller to know about THIS answer before acting on it, each {code, message, says} with message and says the same sentence. Empty is the normal case and is not a guarantee.
